note: Numbers move on SPECIFIC designs only, not across the board: three separate bugs in how a protuberance or camera shroud is priced. A bump on a rocket whose widest part is not the airframe (tube fins, launch lugs) was referenced to the wrong area — 2.78x too much on a 24 mm body with 40 mm tube fins, so it delivered a third of the drag its own method calls for. A Cd of 0 — the slider's left stop — flew as no drag at all; blank and 0 now both mean 'take it from the class'. And a Cd override on a body part distorted the body drag a streamlined bump is measured against. Also: hovering a results chart now shows the exact value at that point (6 significant digits, not 2 decimals), the .xlsx export went from 3 chart tabs to about 31 — one for every column it exports — and RASAero .CDX1 exports carry your motors, with a multi-stage design's weight now in the cell RASAero actually reads.
